authorization: Explicit latest user strategy relayed by primary: planner supplies one heading turn; once aligned resume continuous cruise until next forward3m trigger. Endpoint precision arrival and originalNBVview observation are removed from reactive execution.

implementation.index0: Existing neutral: temporarily use latest actual estimated XYZ and orientation each source tick; retain goal object and lease.
implementation.index1: External pure-turn for any mission in project profile: temporarily use latest actual estimated XYZ each source tick, preserve externally requested target orientation/yaw exactly. Source guide therefore receives zero XYZ error; actual velocity, yaw error/yawrate and source dwell still determine reached.
implementation.reactive_real: mission_id=nbv-reactive and waypoint_index>=12 call the original Tracker.tick directly. Rolling1m cruise target and yaw remain supplied by native/bridge. No heading wrapper, align, observe or adapter endpoint-stop gate; source guide output/report is unchanged.
implementation.legacy_real: Other missions at real indices>=12 retain the prior align/translate/observe wrapper for compatibility.
implementation.restoration: finally restores the original target pose only; a goal cleared by source failure/invalid state remains cleared.
implementation.report: Source reports mission_id=nbv-reactive, original external index1 or real>=12, generation and original source fields unchanged.

source.method: Actual upstream Tracker class parsed as AST; only ROS Node/publishers and monotonic clock mocked. Actual core.guide/yaw/settling_reference imported from retained upstream source.

validation.command: docker run --rm --name pelagos-stonefish --network none --entrypoint /bin/bash [read-only project/upstream mounts] UI5e0aa4 -lc: source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash; source /opt/uw_underlay/setup.bash; source /opt/pelagos/interfaces/setup.bash; append source controller/robot/navigation to sourced PYTHONPATH; cd /pelagos; /opt/research/bin/python3 -m unittest Simulation.tests.test_neutral_navigation Simulation.tests.test_sensor_alignment Simulation.tests.test_clock_control_tick -v
validation.initial_environment_attempt: Initial explicit PYTHONPATH replaced sourced ROS paths and could not import nav_msgs. Corrected command preserves sourced PYTHONPATH; all44 actual source tests then passed.

limits: No live turn/cruise success claimed by these source tests.

Reactive cruise retains source position guidance; an unrenewed goal can naturally reach zero positional error. The bridge owns continuous fresh rolling targets and must not treat source reached as reactive endpoint/observe completion.
The native source gain still uses its sampled view yaw while latest user execution skips that gaze; this adapter does not change gain or claim that gaze was executed.
